name: whip-pan reveal settles into the final logo and tagline card
looks: A fast horizontal whip with a chromatic-aberration streak clears to reveal the wordmark, which settles centred on a plain dark field. A three-line tagline fades in beneath it, then a small handle and URL line, and the frame holds before fading to black.
build: A single layer renders the whip as a motion-blurred, colour-split copy of the wordmark translating across frame on power3.out over about 250-350ms; once it settles, the tagline and handle fade and rise in on their own beats (opacity 0 to 1, y 8px to 0, power2.out), each about 150-200ms after the last, then the whole card fades on the clock.
sound: A whoosh through the whip-pan, a soft low swell under the hold, and the bed fading out over the last second.
prompt: Clear a fast, motion-blurred whip-pan into the brand's lockup settled centre-frame, then let a short tagline and a handle or URL line fade in beneath it one after another, and hold the finished card a beat before the audio fades out.
